gloss: to pour into; to invest heavily in

definitions.gloss: to pour into, to fill by pouring
definitions.explanation: To pour a liquid into a container or space.

definitions.gloss: to invest, to devote, to channel into
definitions.explanation: To put a large amount of money, time, effort, or emotion into something. Implies concentrated, intensive investment.

examples.japanese: コップに{水|みず}を{注|そそ}ぎ{込|こ}む。
{鍋|なべ}にスープを{注|そそ}ぎ{込|こ}んだ。
examples.english: I poured the soup into the pot.

examples.japanese: {川|かわ}の{水|みず}が{海|うみ}に{注|そそ}ぎ{込|こ}んでいる。
examples.english: The river water is flowing into the sea.

examples.japanese: {研究|けんきゅう}に{情熱|じょうねつ}を{注|そそ}ぎ{込|こ}む。
{会社|かいしゃ}は{新製品|しんせいひん}の{開発|かいはつ}に{莫大|ばくだい}な{資金|しきん}を{注|そそ}ぎ{込|こ}んだ。
examples.english: The company invested enormous funds into developing the new product.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもの{教育|きょういく}に{時間|じかん}と{労力|ろうりょく}を{注|そそ}ぎ{込|こ}んできた。
examples.english: I have been devoting time and effort to my children's education.

notes:
USAGE:
Sense 1 is the literal meaning of pouring liquid. Sense 2 is figurative and very common, used for investing money, time, effort, or emotion into something.

WORD FORMATION:
{注|そそ}ぐ (to pour) + {込|こ}む (into). The {込|こ}む suffix emphasizes the action going deeply into something.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {資金|しきん}を{注|そそ}ぎ{込|こ}む: to pour in funds
- {情熱|じょうねつ}を{注|そそ}ぎ{込|こ}む: to pour in passion
- {愛情|あいじょう}を{注|そそ}ぎ{込|こ}む: to pour in love
- {全力|ぜんりょく}を{注|そそ}ぎ{込|こ}む: to pour in all one's effort
- {時間|じかん}を{注|そそ}ぎ{込|こ}む: to invest time
